y_true.description: Ground truth values. shape = `[batch_size, d0, .. dN]`.

y_pred.description: The predicted values. shape = `[batch_size, d0, .. dN]`.
constraints: y_true shape rank must match y_pred shape rank - 1

output.description: Poisson loss values with shape = `[batch_size, d0, .. dN-1]`.
